name: document-3x2-degraded-host-fallback
title: Document degraded one-host fallback for 3x2 review escalation
description: Update the 3x2 review escalation execution plan to allow an honest degraded 3-round x 1-host fallback when a second host is unavailable, unauthenticated, rate-limited, or out of credits, while preserving 3x2 as the default and recording the degraded assurance level explicitly.
